name: bento-grid
title: Bento Grid
description: A free React bento grid in Tailwind CSS: tiles of different sizes where one soft light follows the pointer across all of them, so the grid reads as a single surface. Tiles rise in one after another when scrolled into view, lift on hover, and take any React node as their visual. Light or dark.
